response.original_title: {{FAQs!@HeLP}}How do I cancel my Seabourn cruise Line?
response.overview: To cancel your Seabourn cruise Line, the first step is to review your booking type and cancellation policy, because fees depend on how far you are from departure and the fare you purchased ☏ +1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK). Seabourn allows cancellations by phone or through an approved electronic reservation system, but they also require written confirmation for the cancellation to be considered valid ☏ +1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK). The cancellation becomes effective at the close of business Pacific Standard Time on the date your cancellation request is received ☏ +1-877-619-8065 or +1-877-619-8065 (UK).
